title: Receipts for opposablemeaning.com/vote
description: A submission: a JSON array of receipts. Rules, topics and a prompt for AI agents: https://github.com/opposablemeaning/vote/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md

status.description: What kind of evidence it is. QUOTE: Their own words, from a recording, transcript or post. COURT RULING: A decision by a judge, jury or court. COURT ORDER: An interim court order (like the ICJ's provisional measures), not a final ruling. COURT FILING: An allegation in a court filing, such as an indictment. OFFICIAL: A government record: a vote tally, an order, an agency release. REPORTED: Reporting by a news outlet. DATA: Published statistics. ESTIMATE: A projection or model (CBO, KFF, researchers), labeled as one. PROPOSED: Proposed, not done. LAW: Enacted law.

caption.description: One claim in plain words, saying only what the source says. Exact quotes go in double quotation marks.

outlet.description: Who published the source: the outlet or the record, e.g. Reuters, Supreme Court opinion, House roll call 123

date.description: When the source was published: YYYY-MM-DD (YYYY-MM or YYYY only when the source gives no day)

url.description: The original source: the outlet or primary record, not a repost, aggregator or screenshot

also.description: A second source, or a list of them (use one when url is paywalled)

note.description: Caveats, context or the exact quote

win.description: true only when the receipt records them being stopped: blocked in court, voted down

id.description: Leave it out. Ids are assigned when a submission is merged.

short.description: A shorter caption for the video. Leave it out.
